thread:
evan: quick favor — can someone run a smoke + tail-latency sweep for vulcan-9b (q4_0 int8 and fp16) on monday? expecting to ship a canary on dedicated next week.

sasha: I can take the smoke pass tomorrow morning. are we targeting 128-token chat requests or 512?

evan: start with 128 and then 512 if smoke looks fine. main concern is 99th pct > 200ms on dedicated pools — we've seen spikes before.

maria: pinging perf infra — liam do we have a spare v100 pool for a quick run or should we use the canary rtx nodes?

liam: rtx canary nodes are free right now, v100 reserved for long runs. rtx should be fine for smoke / tail sweep. I'll queue a small job.

bench-bot: queued: vulcan-9b | variant=q4_0 | seq=128 | batch=8 | nodes=rtx-canary-02 | run_id=vb-3167-1

evan: thanks. can you also dump the perf profile and the kernel-level timeline (nvprof/cuprof or similar)? want to check attention tiling weirdness.

sasha: will collect trace + kv cache heatmap. any special prompts to include?

evan: include: one short chat (system + user 40 tokens) and one long few-shot generation ~400 tokens to exercise KV cache.

bench-bot: run complete (smoke). summary below:

```
vulcan-9b q4_0 smoke summary (seq=128, batch=8)
throughput (tok/s): p50=9200 p90=8700 p99=7200
latency per request (ms): p50=18 p90=45 p99=210
tail events: 6/500 requests > 250ms (spike correlates with kernel fallback)
mem: peak=13.6GB
notes: intermittent kernel fallback on torch->custom_attention for some prompt shapes
```

bench-bot: artifact links: s3://redwood-bench/vulcan/vb-3167-1/{trace.pb,kv_heatmap.png,bench.log}

maria: p99=210ms on rtx is borderline but expected. fp16 run would give us lower p99 typically. want me to run fp16 next or try seq=512?

evan: run fp16 next (same batch). if fp16 p99 < 150ms we can canary with an fp16 variant and fallback to q4 on overload.

liam: starting fp16 job now. note: need to enable attention kernel patch in runtime-commit 2f8b9 or else we'll hit fallback. Sasha, can you confirm the canary nodes have that commit?

sasha: nodes are on 2f8b9 in canary pool, yes.

bench-bot: queued: vulcan-9b | variant=fp16 | seq=128 | batch=8 | nodes=rtx-canary-02 | run_id=vb-3167-2

bench-bot: run complete (fp16). summary below:

```
vulcan-9b fp16 smoke summary (seq=128, batch=8)
throughput (tok/s): p50=13800 p90=13200 p99=12000
latency per request (ms): p50=12 p90=30 p99=120
tail events: 1/500 requests > 200ms (trace shows long SPMD sync at step 7)
mem: peak=18.2GB
notes: stable, no attention kernel fallback observed
```

evan: nice. can someone post the perf trace and a short writeup for the onboarding doc? include: recommended default variant (fp16), expected p99 targets, and fallbacks.

sasha: I'll prepare a 2-paragraph note and attach traces. planning to add a small follow-up to verify seq=512 next week before canary rollout.

maria: action items: 1) upload traces + heatmap to onboarding folder, 2) add fp16 as default serving variant in model manifest with q4 fallback policy, 3) schedule seq=512 extended run.

evan: perfect. thanks all — cc @bench-bot for artifacts.

liam: FYI i'll open a tiny runtime PR toggling the attention kernel autopatch guard for vulcan-9b to reduce fallback chance. will ping for review. :thumbsup:
